subject: Startups
title: Airbnb: From Conferences to Travel
description: A quick win: understand Airbnb: From Conferences to Travel.

hook.text: Airbnb started when two broke designers rented air mattresses in their apartment during a sold-out conference.

buildup.text: They called it AirBed & Breakfast. Early traction came only during big events when hotels were fully booked.

discovery.text: They pivoted from events-only to everyday travel. That shift turned a gimmick into a global hospitality platform.

twist.text: Hotels mocked them. Investors said strangers would never sleep in each other's homes. Y Combinator barely accepted them.

climax.text: Airbnb is now worth over $80 billion. The air mattress idea became the largest lodging company that owns no hotels.

punchline.text: An air mattress gimmick became an $80 billion company.
